denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: April 19, 2022
Claim: Rhinoplasty, April 2022
Reason Code: CO-K5

Benefits are not available for the above procedure. The submitted documentation describes the
procedure as performed to improve appearance. There is no indication of functional impairment or
of reconstruction following injury or surgery. Cosmetic procedures are excluded under
Section 4.3.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days of this notice.
denial_reason: Benefits are not available for the above procedure. The submitted documentation describes the procedure as performed to improve appearance. There is no indication of functional impairment or of reconstruction following injury or surgery. Cosmetic procedures are excluded under Section 4.3.

sub_claims.text: The submitted documentation describes the procedure as performed to improve appearance.
sub_claims.rationale: The policy explicitly states in Section 4.3 that the plan does not provide benefits for cosmetic surgery, defining it as a procedure performed principally to improve appearance and not to restore bodily function (p-4-3). Additionally, Section 4.4 clarifies that reconstructive surgery to restore function is not considered cosmetic surgery (p-4-4). The sub-claim that the submitted documentation describes the procedure as performed to improve appearance directly contradicts these policy provisions.

sub_claims.rationale: The provided evidence does not explicitly address whether there was functional impairment or reconstruction following injury or surgery. While Sections 4.3 and 4.4 discuss the distinction between cosmetic and reconstructive surgery, they do not provide information on the presence of functional impairment or reconstruction in this specific case.

evidence.text:
This plan does not provide benefits for cosmetic surgery. Cosmetic surgery means a procedure
performed principally to improve appearance and not to restore bodily function.

Reconstructive surgery to restore function following injury, infection, disease, or a prior
covered surgery is not cosmetic surgery for purposes of Section 4.3.

Surgical services are covered when Medically Necessary and furnished by a participating
provider.
